items.name: a-raider-frenzy
items.subject: FRENZY: a pack of small stocky ants with blue blade fins on their backs, mandibles wide, crowding together; a violet pheromone haze rising off them. Energy colour: hot violet.

items.name: a-needler-barbed-needles
items.subject: BARBED NEEDLES: a single long bronze chitin needle with backward-hooked barbs and a glowing violet tip, piercing through a cracked armour plate. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-burster-rupture
items.subject: RUPTURE: the Burster's huge sac of glowing blue-violet liquid substance bursting open in a splash-explosion of luminous violet liquid, drops flying outward. Energy colour: bright violet liquid light.

items.name: a-burster-unstable
items.subject: UNSTABLE: a round sac of sloshing violet liquid substance bound in royal-blue straps, glowing and trembling, a crack of light at its seam, about to burst. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-major-guard
items.subject: GUARD: the Major's huge armoured bronze head and great leaf-shaped royal-blue shield, seen head-on, sheltering small ants behind it. Energy colour: warm amber and blue.

items.name: a-major-plug
items.subject: PLUG: the Major plants its enormous armoured head into a round clay tunnel mouth like a door, sealing it; arrows glancing off the domed head. Energy colour: steel-blue and amber.

items.name: a-found
items.subject: FOUND A MOUND: a winged ant lands and sheds its translucent blue-violet wings, a small sculpted sand-clay mound spire with a glowing oval tunnel mouth rising from the earth where it lands. Energy colour: violet and warm sand.

items.name: a-bullet-agony
items.subject: AGONY: the Bullet Ant's huge glowing violet stinger striking down, a shockwave of pain rippling out from the impact. Energy colour: searing violet and white.

items.name: a-bullet-giant-killer
items.subject: GIANT KILLER: a small dark red-black ant with a golden bristle mane facing a towering shadowed enemy, its mandibles open wide, fearless. Energy colour: gold and violet.

items.name: a-herald-trail
items.subject: TRAIL: a glowing ribbon of blue-violet pheromone mist laid along the ground, ant footprints racing along it toward the horizon. Energy colour: luminous blue-violet.

items.name: a-herald-alarm
items.subject: ALARM: the Herald raises its golden-feathered staff, a ring of blazing amber-red alarm pheromone bursting outward, antennae of ants around it standing up. Energy colour: blazing amber.

items.name: a-herald-panic
items.subject: PANIC: a cloud of sour violet pheromone mist in which enemy silhouettes stumble back in fear, scattering. Energy colour: sickly-sweet violet.

items.name: a-gardener-fungus-circle
items.subject: FUNGUS CIRCLE: a fairy ring of small glowing pale-and-violet mushrooms sprouting from the ground in a circle, soft healing light rising from it. Energy colour: soft violet and cream.

items.name: a-gardener-spore-cloud
items.subject: SPORE CLOUD: a big pale mushroom cap releasing a dense billowing cloud of glowing violet spores. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-reaver-devour
items.subject: DEVOUR: the Reaver Queen's enormous hooked mandibles closing around a struggling enemy silhouette, swallowing it whole. Energy colour: violet glow from her eyes.

items.name: a-reaver-rampage
items.subject: RAMPAGE: the long armoured royal-blue-and-bronze Reaver Queen charging diagonally, enemies flung aside, dust and blades. Energy colour: violet and dust.

items.name: a-reaver-royal-presence
items.subject: ROYAL PRESENCE: the Reaver Queen's crowned armoured head seen from the front, violet glowing eyes, waves of royal authority radiating. Energy colour: royal blue and violet.

items.name: a-reaver-molt
items.subject: MOLT: an old cracked bronze carapace splitting open along the back, a fresh soft glowing royal-blue body emerging from it. Energy colour: violet light.

items.name: a-reaver-ravenous
items.subject: RAVENOUS: the Reaver Queen's gaping mandibled maw, drooling glowing violet liquid, hungry. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-queen-royal-jelly
items.subject: ROYAL JELLY: the Queen's hand offering a glowing golden drop of royal jelly, light pouring from it. Energy colour: golden amber.

items.name: a-queen-one-body
items.subject: ONE BODY: many ants linked by glowing threads of violet light into one shape, like a single body made of many. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-queen-exodus
items.subject: EXODUS: a column of ants pouring down into a glowing violet tunnel mouth in the earth, swirling into the underground. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-alchemist-volatile-draught
items.subject: VOLATILE DRAUGHT: a glass flask of glowing violet liquid substance flying through the air, about to shatter. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-alchemist-transfusion
items.subject: TRANSFUSION: two streams of glowing red life and violet substance flowing through the air from one body into a flask held by the alchemist. Energy colour: crimson and violet.

items.name: a-alchemist-crystallise
items.subject: CRYSTALLISE: a figure encased in a smooth glassy shell of hardened violet liquid substance, like an insect in amber but violet. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-alchemist-overdose
items.subject: OVERDOSE: an ant warrior swelling with glowing violet substance, veins of light, eyes blazing, rearing in power. Energy colour: blazing violet.

items.name: a-general-mandible-charge
items.subject: MANDIBLE CHARGE: the General leaping forward with two curved glowing blades and wide mandibles, seizing a foe. Energy colour: violet blade-light.

items.name: a-general-mark-prey
items.subject: MARK PREY: a glowing violet pheromone mark, a target-like ring of scent painted on an enemy silhouette. Energy colour: violet.

items.name: a-general-war-column
items.subject: WAR COLUMN: a marching column of armoured ants under a royal-blue banner, seen head-on, in perfect step. Energy colour: royal blue and gold.

items.name: a-general-bivouac
items.subject: BIVOUAC: a living fortress made of interlocked ants, their bodies forming walls and a dome, mandibles outward. Energy colour: amber and blue.

items.name: r-ants-wider-tunnels
items.subject: WIDER TUNNELS: a wide round tunnel mouth in sculpted sand clay, its walls smoothed and widened, soft violet light deep inside.

items.name: r-ants-mandibles
items.subject: MANDIBLES: a pair of hooked bronze chitin mandibles honed to a gleaming edge.

items.name: r-ants-needle-hardening
items.subject: NEEDLE HARDENING: a bundle of three long bronze chitin needles, tips hardened to a glassy violet sheen.

items.name: r-ants-carapace
items.subject: CARAPACE: a thick overlapping bronze carapace plate with a royal-blue painted band, layered like armour.

items.name: r-ants-barbed-needles
items.subject: BARBED NEEDLES: one long chitin needle with backward-hooked barbs along its shaft.

items.name: r-ants-volatile-sacs
items.subject: VOLATILE SACS: a glowing round sac of sloshing violet liquid substance, swollen and taut.

items.name: r-ants-living-wall
items.subject: LIVING WALL: a great leaf-shaped royal-blue shield fused with thick bronze chitin, reinforced.

items.name: r-ants-sticky-nectar
items.subject: STICKY NECTAR: a thick golden-amber drop of nectar stretching in sticky strands.

items.name: r-ants-pheromone-mastery
items.subject: PHEROMONE MASTERY: two feathery golden antennae with curling ribbons of violet pheromone mist between them.

items.name: r-ants-hardened-wings
items.subject: HARDENED WINGS: a pair of translucent blue-violet insect wings with thickened bronze veins.

items.name: r-ants-venom-glands
items.subject: VENOM GLANDS: a glowing violet venom gland and a hooked stinger dripping a luminous drop.

items.name: b-ants-venom-spire
items.subject: the VENOM SPIRE, an upgraded ant acid tower: three sculpted sand-clay spires with glowing violet venom mouths, venom dripping, royal-blue drapes, more menacing than the plain tower.
